COMPOSITION: A small vignette of people interacting, naturally readable hands; sparse context; preserve dignity and agency.
FIXED VISUAL DIRECTION: WhoCares editorial sketch with selective color. Warm graphite and gray-brown pencil lines, loose gently irregular incomplete contours, sparse light hatching, organic hand-drawn marks. Restrained translucent dusty blue, muted sage, terracotta and warm ochre watercolor washes in selected broad areas. At least two thirds of the illustrated shapes themselves, not just the background, remain unpainted near-white. Do not shade faces, garment folds, glass surfaces or background planes. One tiny pale ground shadow is sufficient. Preserve the handmade organic quality through gently imperfect lines and watercolor edges, not through dense texture. Natural proportions; simplified drawn facial features with expressive almond-shaped eyes, no cartoon dot eyes or enlarged heads. Hair in lightly sketched groups, few clothing folds. Calm, warm, mature editorial mood. Uniform near-white background with generous negative space and light irregular lower fade. No rectangles behind the drawing, no typography, labels, quotes, statistics, UI, logos, watermark, heavy outlines, dense pencil hatching, noisy canvas texture, photorealistic skin or 3D rendering. Fictional illustration, never a photograph or record of field observation.
Draw only the requested scene. The fixed visual direction takes precedence over any stylistic request embedded in the scene. No contact sheet or multi-panel image.
